mapper.select: select t1.book_id as bookId, ifnull(t2.book_name, '未知作品') as bookName, ifnull(sum(t1.income_account), 0) as incomeAccount, ifnull(sum(t1.income_count), 0) as incomeCount, ifnull(sum(t1.income_number), 0) as incomeNumber from author_income_detail t1 left join book t2 on t1.book_id = t2.id where t1.user_id = #{userId} and t1.book_id > 0 and t1.book_id = #{bookId} and t1.income_date >= #{startTime} and t1.income_date <= #{endTime} group by t1.book_id, t2.book_name order by incomeAccount desc
